name: @pipeworx/mcp-west-virginia-code

tools.name: wv_code_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the West Virginia Code — West Virginia state law — by citation. "W. Va. Code 61-2-1" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does West Virginia Code 61-2-1 say" or to check a WV statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "61-2-1" (murder) or "17C-5-2" (DUI). Chapter-article-section.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-west-virginia-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the west-virginia-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
